174.news_title: Nova Blast Monitor Replacement with the Arcooda 26inch UHD Arcade Monitor
174.long_description: Replacing or upgrading your Nova Blast arcade cabinet with the Arcooda 26inch arcade LCD monitor is plug and play with our custom mounting brackets. With the highest 4x3 aspect ratio, enjoy 2880x2160 video resolution on your Nova Blast machine. If you are looking to upgrade or replace your existing Nova Blast arcade monitor, we have now designed a mount bracket set that matches our 26inch 4x3 aspect ratio UHD arcade monitor. When ordering the 26inch UHD monitor, there will be an option for the Nova Blast arcade cabinet brackets, these will be included for free. Enjoy native 15khz up to 2880x2160 video resolution, with low input lag, and full support of RGB, VGA, DVI and DisplayPort inputs. The mounting brackets have been made with the support of the Nova Blast community.
